title: Timeline for Schools to Return to Normalcy with COVID-19 Endemic Status in Singapore
what_it_is: Timeline for Schools to Return to Normalcy with COVID-19 Endemic Status in Singapore

sections.label: In-person CCA suspension status
sections.summary: In-person CCAs resumed in August for secondary level and above, but were suspended from 27 September; primary school CCAs remain suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: In-person CCAs and enrichment activities at the secondary-level and above, including our Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs), resumed in August this year with the relevant safe management measures in place.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: With the tightening of the community safe management measures in the Stabilisation Phase from 27 September, MOE had suspended in-person CCAs and enrichment activities for secondary and junior college/Millenia Institute students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: For primary school students who are not yet eligible to be vaccinated, we have taken a more cautious approach, with in-person CCAs still suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are monitoring the situation carefully and will decide at an appropriate juncture when to resume in-person CCAs and activities in a safe manner, complemented by stringent safe management and surveillance measures.
